name: emdo-medical-platform
description: EMDO Medical platform monorepo. Prototype implementation of the foundation, EMDO Record, EMDO Care, EMDO Assist, the M10 Insight aggregate API and the local Super Admin portal.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @emdo/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @emdo/admin
scripts.migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run migrate -w @emdo/api
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build:shared && npm run bootstrap -w @emdo/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @emdo/shared && npm run test -w @emdo/api && npm run test -w @emdo/admin
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @emdo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
